context: Sho excitedly tells Asuka about an upcoming school presentation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 先生、今度の学習発表、ぼく、発表する役、もらった！
lines.en: Sensei, I got the role to present at the learning presentation.
lines.style: Quiet pride barely contained. Small voice, steady delivery. Genuine warmth without seeking applause. The kind of announcement a reserved six-year-old makes when something real has happened.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: え、すごい！しょうくん、本当に、頑張ってる。
lines.en: That's wonderful! Sho-kun, you've really been working so hard.
lines.style: Genuine delight, not performed. Warm recognition that lands softly. Slight lift on 頑張ってる — not gushing, but letting him feel that she truly sees his effort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm nervous, but I'll do my best.
lines.style: Honest acknowledgment of the fear, then immediate quiet resolve. No false brightness. The small determined voice of someone taking something seriously.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先生も、絶対、見に行く。応援してる。
lines.en: Sensei will definitely come. I'm cheering for you.
lines.style: Steady, unhurried assurance. The teacher leaning in slightly with her attention fully on him. A promise made simply, with the weight that matters to a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ありがとう、先生。本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Thank you, sensei. I'm really happy.
lines.style: Soft gratitude, genuine relief. Small voice softening at the end. Not exuberant — the quiet happiness of a child who just had something he worried about become real and safe.
